title: PNP hunts ‘digital predator’ linked to Caloocan school stabbing

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines—The Philippine National Police’s (PNP) cybercrime investigators are tracking down an alleged online groomer or “digital predator” who encouraged a 12-year-old student to stab two classmates inside a public elementary school in Caloocan City. “I have ordered the PNP Anti-Cybercrime Group to immediately trace, identify, and hunt down this digital predator in full coordination with foreign and local cyber-intelligence partners,” PNP chief Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr. said on Thursday. “Exploiting a minor’s vulnerability to incite real-world violence is a serious crime, and we will pursue this perpetrator wherever they are hiding online,” he added.
